page.layout: One page of text, single column, running head at top centre; below the text a blank area with a large initial "IN" at the right, starting a new section. No margin notes.

main_text.p: yunt partes, in oratione non intexi tantum, sed nudari prope volunt. vt, quod Græcis olim vsitatum dicitur, ad alia propemodum transferri possint. Qui vicissim hoc à nobis discant, frustra didicisse artem, qui dissimulare eam nondum didicit. Hoc enim ipsum ars est, sed quam nemo docet: cura autem sola & judicium absoluit.
main_text.head: IN

page.notes: The running head reads "AD LECTOREM" in small capitals. The first line is partly damaged at its left edge ("yunt partes" is a fragment of "sunt partes"). The "IN" at the right is a large initial standing alone, probably the start of the following section, so it is given as a heading. Heavy show-through and stains fill the lower part of the page; no further legible text is present.
